assertions.assertion: Program.cs calls builder.AddSqlServer() to create a SQL Server resource
assertions.rationale: The response calls builder.AddSqlServer("sql") to provision the SQL Server resource.

assertions.assertion: Program.cs calls .AddDatabase() to create a database resource from the SQL Server
assertions.rationale: It calls sql.AddDatabase("identitydb") to create the database resource.

assertions.assertion: The IdentityServer project uses both .WithReference(identityDb) and .WaitFor() for the SQL Server or database resource
The Weather API project uses both .WithReference(identityServer) and .WaitFor(identityServer)
The Web App project uses both .WithReference(identityServer) and .WaitFor(identityServer)
